docRequirement: `claudeMdExcludes` is a settings key readable at ANY settings scope — user, project, local, or managed — and the arrays MERGE across scopes: "You can set `claudeMdExcludes` at any [settings scope](/docs/en/settings#configuration-scopes): user, project, local, or managed. Arrays merge across scopes, so a team can set project-level defaults while individuals add local overrides." (large-codebases.md:155). The page's canonical placement is the LOCAL scope — "If you only want these exclusions for yourself, put the setting in `.claude/settings.local.json`" (:137), with the worked example a `.claude/settings.local.json` holding `{"claudeMdExcludes": ["**/packages/web/**"]}` (:140-145) that "skips every CLAUDE.md and rules file under that package" (:147), and :426 repeating "Add it to the repository root's `.claude/settings.local.json`". Only managed policy CLAUDE.md FILES are un-excludable (:155, settings.md:250); the managed SCOPE may still set the key.
current: One scope is read, and that scope cannot carry the key. `getConfiguredInstructionExcludes()` (packages/shared/src/agent/memory/instruction-excludes.ts:60-80) calls `loadStoredConfig()` and merges only the two key spellings in `INSTRUCTION_EXCLUDE_SETTING_KEYS` (:28, `['instructionExcludes','claudeMdExcludes']`) inside that one object. `loadStoredConfig` (packages/shared/src/config/storage.ts:793) reads exactly one file, `CONFIG_FILE = join(CONFIG_DIR, 'config.json')` (storage.ts:152), and CONFIG_DIR is the user-level `~/.nessy-agent` (packages/shared/src/config/paths.ts:18-21). Neither key is declared in `StoredConfigKnownFields` (packages/shared/src/config/validators.ts:143-202) and `StoredConfigTopLevelSchema = z.object(StoredConfigKnownFields).strict()` (validators.ts:208), so storage.ts:856-862 THROWS `UnsupportedStorageLayoutError` on either spelling. Verified by disk round-trip (temp CONFIG_DIR, v2 config.json + `"instructionExcludes": ["/tmp/monorepo/other-team/**"]`): `loadStoredConfig THREW: UnsupportedStorageLayoutError | config.json has an unknown or invalid top-level setting. Refusing to load it: Unrecognized key: "instructionExcludes"`, and `getConfiguredInstructionExcludes() -> []` because its own try/catch (instruction-excludes.ts:62-66) swallows the throw. Same result for `claudeMdExcludes`. So the exclusion list is ALWAYS empty in production and the one exclusion pass at packages/shared/src/capabilities/native-sources.ts:1131-1133 drops nothing; `createInstructionExcludeMatcher([])` returns `() => false` (instruction-excludes.ts:47). No project-, local- or managed-scope source is consulted: `.claude/settings.json` and `.claude/settings.local.json` ARE discovered (native-sources.ts:1051-1059) but only as `'permission'` records, and only their `permissions` block is parsed (packages/shared/src/agent/permissions-config.ts:511-564, `claudeSettingsPermissionDsl` reads `root.permissions` at :517-520 and nothing else); the managed policy's key allowlist `MANAGED_PI_POLICY_KEYS` (packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-policy.ts:501) has no such key and `refuseUnknownKeys` (:727, called at :1215) rejects it; the `.nessy-agent` project tier (native-sources.ts:1013-1043) has no settings file at all. `grep -an 'claudeMdExcludes\|instructionExcludes'` over packages/ apps/ (NUL-safe) finds no other reader. The only remaining injection seam, `env.instructionExcludes` (native-sources.ts:65, consumed at :889-891), has no production writer — the sole production caller is packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/storage-runtime.ts:641 `deps.nativeSourcesEnv ?? {}`, and every setter of `nativeSourcesEnv` is a `__tests__` file. The lazy nested-instruction channel calls the user-only reader with no scope at all (packages/shared/src/agent/base-agent.ts:1242-1244).
divergence: Two deltas, stacked. (1) SCOPE: four documented scopes with array merge, one implemented — user only, and merged only across the two key SPELLINGS inside that single file, not across scopes. The doc's primary placement (`.claude/settings.local.json`) is parsed by us for `permissions` only, so it is silently inert; project `.claude/settings.json` likewise; the managed policy schema rejects the key outright. (2) The one implemented scope is itself broken, which is not scope-narrowing but a contradiction: `~/.nessy-agent/config.json` is the only file the reader consults, and the strict top-level envelope rejects both `instructionExcludes` and `claudeMdExcludes`, so the value is never read AND the whole config refuses to load. This is exactly the R4 startup-brick class the repo already documents — "a key the StoredConfig TYPE declares but the strict top-level envelope (`StoredConfigTopLevelSchema`) never learned bricks app startup with UnsupportedStorageLayoutError the moment a real config.json sets it" (packages/shared/src/config/__tests__/session-mirror-settings.test.ts:1-8) — except here the key is not even in the `StoredConfig` type. Net: the matcher, the glob semantics, the inventory filter and the lazy-channel hook are all correct and all fed an array that is provably always empty. Nothing about the pattern semantics needs changing.

userImpact: Two concrete failures, and one of them is a brick. (1) The `/context` overlay tells the user to use this setting — "Memory and instruction files cost {{tokens}} tokens. Review them with /memory, or drop the ones this project does not need with the instructionExcludes setting." (en.json:593, rendered by context-overlay.tsx:36-41 for the `trim_memory_files` suggestion). A user who follows that advice and adds `instructionExcludes` to `~/.nessy-agent/config.json` — the only file that is read — makes `loadStoredConfig()` throw `UnsupportedStorageLayoutError: config.json has an unknown or invalid top-level setting. Refusing to load it: Unrecognized key: "instructionExcludes"` (measured). In the desktop app that throw lands at apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:415, inside the un-caught `app.whenReady().then(async () => { … })` continuation opened at :332, so startup stops long before `createInitialWindows()` at :1180: the app runs with no window and no dialog, and the only way out is editing the JSON back by hand. (2) A user who follows the PAGE instead — `.claude/settings.local.json` with `{"claudeMdExcludes": ["**/packages/web/**"]}`, the doc's worked example — gets silence: the file is read only for its `permissions` block, so every ancestor `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` and every `.claude/rules/*` file under the excluded package still lands in the pinned capability block and still bills tokens on every turn, exactly the monorepo cost the page exists to remove. Nothing warns, and `/context` keeps repeating the suggestion that cannot be acted on.
